lines.x: Gold prices in Egypt declined by EGP 500 over the past week, with 21-karat gold falling over 8.4%.
Egypt's Planning Minister announced real GDP grew 4.9% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026/2027, surpassing international forecasts.
Egypt's foreign exchange reserves crossed $57.5 billion while commercial bank assets rose EGP 763 billion in July to reach EGP 28.424 trillion.
Egypt reached a $2.3 billion agreement with the IMF following a 5.1% GDP growth rate in the 2025–2026 fiscal year, supported by tourism and Suez Canal revenues.
